title: fix(app-shell): a screen-flow result screen draws Done, and closing it completes the run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VWCXoujnsz5LFXGfY9fWyR)_
Fixes #26902

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:屏幕流的「结果屏」(所有字段都是只读 `record_link`、且引擎说后面没有下一屏)底部只剩一个「完成」;点「完成」、右上角 X、按 Esc、点遮罩,都会以空输入恢复运行并照 Submit 的路径收尾(成功提示、刷新数据、`onComplete`)。
- 为什么改:以前这一屏还画「取消 + 提交」,取消和关闭只关掉对话框,运行一直挂起、宿主页不刷新,刚转化的线索仍显示 Qualified,「取消」还像能撤销已写入的记录。
- 风险与回滚:只动控制台 `FlowRunner` 的底部按钮与关闭处理,以及一个新判定 `isDisplayOnlyScreen`;有输入的屏、无字段的纯消息屏、引擎说还有下一屏的只读步骤、`object-form` 步骤、失败/拒绝的终态都保持原样。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx` 的 `resultScreen` / `dismiss` 两行与底部分支;`ScreenView.tsx` 的 `isDisplayOnlyScreen`;新测试 `FlowRunner.resultScreen-26902.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/FlowRunner.resultScreen-26902.test.tsx`,预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`FlowRunner` (the console's screen-flow dialog) now treats a **result screen** as something the user acknowledges, not cancels:

- New predicate `isDisplayOnlyScreen(screen)` in `ScreenView.tsx`, beside `isRecordLinkScreenField`: a flat screen that declares at least one field, every one of them `type: 'record_link'` (matched exactly, as the engine's resume rule matches it). `record_link` is the only member of the spec's open screen-field `type` vocabulary that takes no input, so this is the whole of "a screen with no input fields". Read over the DECLARED fields, like the dialog width, so the answer never changes while the screen is open.
- On such a screen, when it is the end of the line (`progress.nextScreen` is `'none'`, or the server serves no `progress`), and the run is not already terminal: the footer is one primary **Done** (the existing `common.done` row, no new i18n row), and Done, the dialog's X, Escape and an outside click all go through `submit()`: resume with no inputs, then take the answer exactly as Submit does (completion toast, `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, `onComplete`; the next screen if the run pauses again; the banner if the resume fails). A close while that resume is in flight is ignored, as on Submit. Once a resume has failed, closing is a plain close again (`onClose`) and Done is the retry, so an outage never traps the user in the dialog.
- A new header section in `FlowRunner.tsx` records the behaviour and its bounds.

Unchanged on purpose:

- A screen with any input field keeps Cancel + Submit, and its Cancel and X still only close.
- A screen with **no fields at all** is not display-only: a message-only step can be the go-ahead for what follows it ("Delete these records?"), so its Cancel must stay a way out.
- A display-only step the engine says another screen follows (`nextScreen` `'certain'` / `'possible'`) keeps Cancel + Next: there Cancel abandons a wizard, and an X that resumed would open the next step instead of closing.
- `object-form` steps and the terminal paths (refused end, terminal failure: a single Close) keep their behaviour.
- `FlowRunnerProps` is unchanged, so neither launch host (`RecordDetailView`, `useConsoleActionRuntime`) changes.

## Why

On the HotCRM `lead_conversion` flow, the last screen is three `record_link` fields (the created account, contact and opportunity). The dialog drew Cancel + Submit; Cancel or the close dismissed the dialog without resuming, so the run stayed suspended, `onComplete` never fired, and the record page kept showing the converted lead as Qualified until a reload. "Cancel" also read as if it could undo the conversion.

The server side completes on the empty resume, so the client is not faking completion: `screen-record-link-resume.test.ts` (service-automation) resumes a record-link result screen with `variables: {}` and asserts success plus the next node's write, and `flow-screen-record-link.dogfood.test.ts` posts `inputs: {}` to the real resume door and asserts the run completes.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/FlowRunner.resultScreen-26902.test.tsx` (11 tests), on the `lead_conversion` shape (a last screen of three `record_link` fields):

- the footer shows Done and no Cancel or Submit;
- Done POSTs the resume with `inputs: {}` and calls `onComplete` once (never `onClose`), one success toast, one `'*'` data change over the real bus;
- the X and Escape each POST the resume and call `onComplete` once;
- a close while the resume is in flight posts nothing more;
- a resume that pauses again draws the next screen (back to Cancel + Submit);
- a retryable failed resume keeps the banner and Done;
- after a retryable failed resume, the X and Escape call `onClose` with no second resume POST, and Done stays enabled;
- controls: a screen with any input keeps Cancel + Submit and its Cancel/X only close; a message-only screen keeps its Cancel; a display-only step with another screen after it keeps Cancel + Next;
- `isDisplayOnlyScreen` truth table (links only, one link, link + text, case-mismatched `Record_Link`, empty, absent `fields`, `object-form`).

## Acceptance notes

- The `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning count in `ScreenView.tsx` rises by one with the new export, the same warning every other helper export in that file already carries; eslint exits 0.
- Ablation (one-shot, not kept): the `dismiss` binding's result-screen arm removed, so it reads `const dismiss = onClose;` (the old close behaviour), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the X/Escape test turns red (`onComplete` never called, 1 failed / 9 passed), then the file is restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Second ablation (on `00147cd2`): the dismiss guard `&& !resumeError` removed: the "after a failed resume the close only closes" test turns red (1 failed / 10 passed), then restored to the HEAD blob `6c27e23d5741`.
